issues.message: 5 anomalous gaps detected (multi-day feed outages in 2004, 2006, 2009, 2011).
2336 bars with |z-return| > 8.0 scattered across 2003-2026, concentrated in 2008, 2013, 2020, 2026.
No 'spread' column present; skip spread validation.

quality_notes.extreme_returns: Distributed across 2003-2026; not confined to 2003. Peak years: 2008 (610), 2013 (157), 2020 (167), 2026 (324). Manual spot-check of sampled extremes confirms genuine volatility spikes (e.g., 2020-03 COVID, 2008 GFC), not vendor stitching errors. No truncation of start date recommended.
quality_notes.gap_handling: 5 anomalous multi-day feed outages recorded: 2004-05-13 (9 days), 2006-01-14 (4 days), 2009-04-26 (3 days), 2009-05-07 (9 days), 2011-04-13 (3 days). Realized-vol trailing windows MUST exclude sessions immediately after these gaps (returns across multi-day gaps are not valid 5-min returns). Feature code updated to flag/exclude sessions adjacent to gaps > 1 hour.
quality_notes.start_date_recommendation: No truncation of 2003 data recommended. Extreme returns in 2003 (49 total) are genuine early-market behavior, not vendor errors. However, realized_vol_trailing_20 requires ~20 sessions warm-up; first ~20 sessions of 2003 should be treated as unstable.
